body:
When trying to use Quarkus `3.0.0.Final` I got:

```
A problem occurred configuring project ':quarkus-extension-gradle-deployment-module-bug'.
> Configuration with name 'annotationProcessor' not found
```

which I have no idea what to do with...
That's really weird, it looks like the java plugin is not correctly applied, this plugin is in charge of registering implementation and annotationProcessor configurations
@glefloch will you have time to look into this one?

If you change the name of the deployment module so that it is lexicographically smaller than the name of the runtime module, e.g. prefix it with an `a`, then it compiles just fine.

I'm guessing Gradle loads modules in lexicographic order. I guess this is why the Java plugin is not applied as you write @glefloch.

This would also explain why it works with the default names `runtime` and `deployment`, since `deployment` is lexicographically 
 smaller than `runtime`.
Thanks for the analysis @AndreasPetersen. I will try to handle that in the extension plugin to force the java plugin application regardless of the module names

Any update on this? I'm running into the same problem. 
I tried figuring out in QuarkusExtensionPlugin.java what goes wrong, but I don't understand half of the lines.

An alternative workaround seems to be to set `quarkusExtension.deploymentModule="name of runtime module"`. This will build without errors or warnings, and will produce a jar-file with a `META-INF/quarkus-extension.properties` with a `deployment-artifact` with the name of the runtime module appended with `-deployment`. I assume this only works if the name of the deployment module is equal to that of the runtime module, with `-deployment` appended.
